name: TECHNAX
recent: Techna-X 正推进两项资产出售：以 RM45 million 脱售 HK Aerospace Beidou 50% 股权，并以 RM7 million 脱售 Chaswood Restaurant Management (Beijing) 45% 股权。公司董事局近期出现变动，Tunku Kamariah 及其子 Tengku Shahrain 在受委后数日内辞任。此外，Bursa Malaysia 于 9 月公开谴责公司。
notable: Bursa Malaysia Securities 于 2026 年 9 月 9 日公开谴责 Techna-X Berhad。
risks: Tunku Kamariah Aminah Maimunah Iskandariah binti Sultan Iskandar 及其子 Tengku Shahrain 在受委后数日内辞去董事职务。
Bursa Malaysia Securities 公开谴责公司。
HK Aerospace Beidou 股权出售的长期截止日期已延长至 2027 年 4 月 18 日，且公司获准延至 2026 年 12 月 3 日提交通函草案。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM3.798 million，环比增长 1.8%，但同比下跌 76.0%；净利为 RM0.708 million，净利率 18.6%，较上季的 1.3% 上升。

recent_en: Techna-X is proceeding with two asset disposals: a 50% stake in HK Aerospace Beidou for RM45 million and a 45% stake in Chaswood Restaurant Management (Beijing) for RM7 million. The board has seen changes, with Tunku Kamariah and her son Tengku Shahrain resigning days after appointment. Bursa Malaysia also publicly reprimanded the company in September.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of 50% equity in HK Aerospace Beidou New Energy Technology to Tess Global Sdn Bhd for RM45 million cash.
Proposed disposal of 45% equity in Chaswood Restaurant Management (Beijing) to ZhengHe International Trade Import & Export (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. for RM7 million.
Bursa Malaysia Securities publicly reprimanded Techna-X Berhad on 9 September 2026.
risks_en: Tunku Kamariah Aminah Maimunah Iskandariah binti Sultan Iskandar and her son Tengku Shahrain resigned from the board days after their appointment.
Bursa Malaysia Securities publicly reprimanded the company.
The long stop date for the HK Aerospace Beidou disposal has been extended to 18 April 2027, and the company has until 3 December 2026 to submit its draft circular.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM3.798 million, up 1.8% QoQ but down 76.0% YoY; net income was RM0.708 million with a net margin of 18.6%, up from 1.3% in the previous quarter.
